Kuodžiai: Lithuania reports four smuggling drones in one operation

30 July 2026 · Kuodžiai · four cross-border smuggling drones

Officially reported cross-border smuggling-drone operation

30 July 2026, evening. Lithuania’s State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported that four cargo drones entered from Belarus and were brought down and recovered in one operation near Kuodžiai, in Lazdijai district.

The recovered cargo totalled 4,000 packs of Belarus-stamped cigarettes. VSAT said a criminal investigation was opened. This is one documented operation, not four separate incident records.

No exact flight track, operator identity or state sponsorship was established. This is a criminal smuggling case, not a military attack.
